description: Stored mention links on live captures (decision 2026-10-02-mail-and-mentions-store), measured from every source that answers: a GET-only sync of the Portal reporting API into a throwaway mirror, one GET-only BC capture pass (the entity sets the host captures, integrations.bc_read.CAPTURE_ENTITY_SETS) into a throwaway capture store and one bounded Graph-delta capture of the allowlisted purchase-order@ mailbox into a throwaway versioned mail capture (integrations/capture_mail.py), all projected under the curated schema (documents domain: Email, Attachment) with ontology.mentions.store_mention_links writing lead mention links into the same store generation, so mail mentions reach BC records as well as Portal ones. A Portal outage blocks parts, not the check: a Portal that is down or not configured is a blocked_upstream part and the rest is measured (blocked in part); with no record source (neither Portal nor BC) or no mail capture the probe names sources_blocked and the check is blocked, never a pass. Pass = no rebuild's content digest differs from the build's (rebuild_digest_mismatches 0: on the session path its cold rebuild is compared, rebuild_digest_equal; on the cold path it builds once and records rebuild_digest_not_asserted cold_path_single_build, determinism at full size being ontology.projection's and ontology.session_projection's), every sampled value passes the claim gate and every sampled citation resolves offline through the served host (operating.host Host.served_tools over the probe's throwaway state, read as the capture principal under examples/projection_probe_audience.live-check.json: bc:// and mail among them), the Portal side is read under a narrowed example audience (examples/projection_probe_mirror_audience.live-check.json), neither an actor without grants nor the reader on what that audience withholds from it gets a row back (denied_objects_probed and, with the Portal up, reader_denied_objects_probed sampled; a trim that did not run reports not_checked and fails), and an actor granted the records but not the mail (probe:mail-withheld-reader) is served 0 mention links through plx.around on every probed linked object. Counts, booleans, gap codes, scheme names and part names only; never a value, key, address or citation. live-unverified until a live result exists. The claims phase stays under 300 s (json_max phase_seconds.claims; live 1,271 s of 1,588 s on 9.39M values before the sample was read by rowid seeks and the role contracts in one pass); claims_timing records its split (scan_seconds reading the sample, gate_seconds the served reads and the claim gate).
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it (module tests are injected-transport: ontology/tests/test_mail_documents.py, including this probe over FakeWorkbench and FakeGraph; verify/tests/test_live_wiring.py runs this spec's argv over the fixture world with the BC fake, Portal up and Portal 500). Its requires are only its session producers, which never block it (a Portal outage blocks parts, not tiers); the Portal env is optional. Daily: in one runner session it tops up mirror.full_coverage's {session_state}/mirror.sqlite and workspace.object_view's {session_state}/ontology.sqlite served state (its BC capture reads only the units that one holds incomplete and its own mail capture, when it makes one, writes into the capture there), else it captures cold (session_state.shared_store false). The capture is bounded at 4 delta pages per folder, so mail_capture_complete may honestly be false (reason page_budget); mention links are recorded, not asserted, because whether any captured message names a mirrored identifier is data. mention_links_visible_to_reader counts the links the served plx.around gives the capture principal (granted the mailbox and BC by examples/projection_probe_audience.live-check.json, the Portal by examples/projection_probe_mirror_audience.live-check.json) on up to 200 linked objects; probe:mail-withheld-reader, granted the same records but not the mail, must be served none (mention_denied_leaks 0) on the linked objects it may read (mention_objects_visible_to_withheld, recorded: whether a mention reaches an object it may read is data). reader_denied_objects_probed is required only with every source up: the narrowing is the Portal audience's. Mention links are leads only (tier ceiling lead); their growth against the projection's size is the decision's falsifier (more than 2x build size or time: move documents to a separate generation file). The probe budget is 2,600 s with --workers 3: with --bc-capture the Portal sync gets half the 60% sync share (780 s) and the BC capture 60% of what is left after it (about 1,090 s with the Portal up, 1,560 s when it fails at once); a BC capture that does not finish is still projected; a spent budget exits 4 with a partial report. With the Portal down the check is blocked in part and counted measured in the projected tier when mail and BC met expect_blocked (mail documents projected, claims and citations checked, no leak). With every source up the full expect also requires a live-read production BC capture and at least one resolved bc:// citation among the sampled claims. Session projection: it also requires ontology.session_projection, its session producer of {session_state}/projection (Portal and BC, service reader), which never blocks it: when this session committed that generation it neither syncs nor captures BC, captures its mail and projects only the units that mail changes on top of that generation (session_projection.mode incremental); its rebuild stays one cold build of the same captures (rebuild_digest_equal, rebuild_digest_mismatches 0); else it builds cold (mode cold) once, with no rebuild: rebuild_digest_not_asserted cold_path_single_build and rebuild_digest_mismatches 0, never rebuild_digest_equal (decision 2026-10-14-mentions-cold-path, option 3: the live cold rebuild needed about 18.6 GB of disk against about 14.7 GB free and was refused disk_insufficient; full-size determinism is asserted by ontology.projection and ontology.session_projection). When that producer captured BC and stopped before it committed (a budget stop in its projection), the cold build's empty BC capture starts as a copy of the producer's (bc_capture.session_seeded) and reuses every unit this session completed (bc_capture.units_reused), reading only the rest. Budget measurement (live b593c374, 2026-10-13 07:03Z, cold: no session producer ran): of the 2,600 s budget the BC capture took 336 s, the first cold build 1,206 s (1,081,328 objects) and the Portal sync (its 780 s share), the served config and the mail capture together about 822 s (not timed apart), so the 236 s left could not hold the second 1,206 s build: two cold builds alone are 2,412 s (the cold path now builds once). On the session path a rebuild that cannot fit is not started; the claim, leak and mention checks still run on the first build and the report is a budget stop at rebuild_skipped (rebuild_skipped true, exit 4, a fail: no determinism verdict) that carries the mention tables and phase_seconds (seconds per phase), so the next live run names where the rest goes before any budget change. bc_capture.unit_reasons counts the units not complete by reason (company_etag_missing: BC lists companies without an etag, a typed unit gap that neither blocks BC nor makes the session's next capture read any unit again); bc_capture.reason is set only for a capture that held nothing. --checks-budget-seconds 2400 (a forecast until a shared run is measured) bounds the shared cost (claims, trim, removals, mentions and the session-path rebuild) so the runner reads it as the non-build budget (option 2). The claim sample is streamed from the store (claims phase was SIGKILLed at 9.2 GB maxrss on 2026-10-16 when it materialised every value).
